title: Affine-chart colimit comparison preserves pointed evaluation
statement: Let Y be a scheme, Ω an algebraically closed field, i : Spec A → Y an open immersion, and xU : Spec Ω → Spec A a geometric point. Put p = xU(closedPoint Ω), F = κ(p), embed F into Ω by xU, and put K = separableClosure F Ω. For any colimit cocone c of the étale residue-triple ring diagram over A,p,K and any ring map ψ : c.pt → K agreeing on each coprojection with its specified triple residue map, there exists a ring-colimit isomorphism e : strictHenselizationRing (xU ≫ i) ≅ c.pt such that inclusion into Ω of ψ(e(a)) equals geometric evaluation of a for every a. No surjectivity of ψ is assumed or concluded. The notions are [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure], and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation].

proof.text: First derive the ring-valued small-model coprojection equation from strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_pointed: cancel isoSpec.inv using isoSpec.hom, then apply the private pointed_ring_equation lemma, proved using Spec.map_injective and toSpecΓ_naturality. Apply colimit.hom_ext to the small affine diagram. The final-functor comparison smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso commutes with coprojections by Functor.Final.ι_colimitIso_hom_assoc, and ι_strictHenselizationEval gives the same evaluation on the corresponding upstream affine pointed neighbourhood. This proves CommRingCat.ofHom (strictHenselizationPointEvaluation x) = (smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso x).hom followed by strictHenselizationEval x.

Apply etale_local_ring_triples to obtain initiality of the chart inclusion, the diagram isomorphism δ, the colimit cocones cn and ct, and their isomorphism s with coprojection equations. Let e0 be smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso from the chosen small affine colimit strictHenselizationRing x to the upstream affine-neighbourhood colimit strictHenselization x. Let e1 be the unique colimit isomorphism from the latter to cn.pt, and e2 the unique colimit isomorphism from ct.pt to the supplied c.pt. Take e = e0 composed with e1 composed with s composed with e2. The comparison isomorphisms commute with the relevant coprojections.

Whisker the affine-neighbourhood colimit cocone by the opposite of the initial chart inclusion. Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv makes this cocone colimiting, so its hom_ext reduces equality of e.hom followed by ψ and the inclusion K to Ω with strictHenselizationEval to each chart neighbourhood. Rewrite using the three comparison coprojection equations and hψ. For a pointed neighbourhood f : Spec Ω → X, the given pointed equation f followed by X.toSpecΓ = Spec.map k followed by Spec.map b followed by Spec.map d implies d followed by b followed by k = f.appTop followed by ΓSpecIso Ω: apply Spec.map_injective, Spec.map_comp, SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom, and toSpecΓ_naturality. This is the proved private pointed_ring_equation helper. It supplies the remaining chart-leg equality. Finally use pointEvaluation_eq_upstream and evaluate the equality of ring homomorphisms at a. Surjectivity of ψ is never used.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_comparison
    {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (A : CommRingCat.{v}) (i : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (xU : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A) :
    let p := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).1
    let F := (Spec A).residueField p
    let emb := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).2
    letI : Algebra F Ω := emb.hom.toAlgebra
    let K := separableClosure F Ω
    ∀ (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A p K
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F K)))) (_hc : IsColimit c)
      (ψ : c.pt →+* K),
      (∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom =
        ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom) →
      ∃ e : strictHenselizationRing (xU ≫ i) ≅ c.pt,
        ∀ a, (ψ (e.hom a) : Ω) = strictHenselizationPointEvaluation (xU ≫ i) a
